scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @newscg/server" "npm run dev -w @newscg/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @newscg/shared && npm run build -w @newscg/server && npm run build -w @newscg/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @newscg/shared && npm run typecheck -w @newscg/server && npm run typecheck -w @newscg/web
